description: A loop's own `as` binding keeps its meaning against a root effect of the same name: inside the loop body, bare {{item}} is the bound string "loop-item" (the each binding), never the root tool effect also named `item`. Already true on main (the loop body's own scope overlay predates #778); pinned here so the new bare-sibling fallback -- consulted only once every existing context key, including this one, has already missed -- never changes it.
